subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/864798b4e3dc298d0da9456db41c2bedb68075190cbaeaea407c6e0657f2ecf7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series → 

The left diagonal elements interchange positions.

The center element and top right corner element interchange positions.

The bottom left corner element is replaced by new element. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc6b1dee21d350d4e608cf52f9c4f4beffd485551d618844ad55b4fa02894039.png] 

2) Second box series →

The top row elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05f41b25047d5aab37ac202cdef3e0d1c3688ee258a31ab96ced393e2b474641.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14c20b92a6534247f28753b223bce424d95e98bbad2d79e483969ec510276cf2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb8d5563075c15c240e4ae87077165bc209d1820b8d963a494cdffa3dd042c9c.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
